description: OpenHRV — open-source, clean-room HRV / readiness / stress tracker on Cloudflare Workers (Hono + D1). Single-user, locked to its owner via Cloudflare Access.
name: openhrv

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.toml --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.toml --local
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml --var GIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD)
